atoms.exact_source_text: Establishment clears remaining Fog in the Reach.
atoms.normalized_claim: Establishment clears remaining Fog in the Reach.

atoms.exact_source_text: It supports Shelter, Launch and relaunch, Tool repair, partial Exposure reduction, Cargo offload, and local staging.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Outpost supports Shelter, Launch and relaunch, Tool repair, partial Exposure reduction, Cargo offload, and local staging.

atoms.exact_source_text: Routine gathering and transport between established locations are abstracted beneath expedition scale.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine gathering and transport between established locations are abstracted beneath expedition scale.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Sustenance-bearing Outpost adds bounded Sustenance to the Gardener’s ongoing Harvest without increasing Gardening Load.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Sustenance-bearing Outpost adds bounded Sustenance to the Gardener's ongoing Harvest without increasing Gardening Load.

atoms.exact_source_text: Most Outposts contribute Perishable Sustenance, while certain authored Reaches or biomes may contribute Durable Sustenance or a mixed yield.
atoms.normalized_claim: Most Outposts contribute Perishable Sustenance, while certain authored Reaches or biomes may contribute Durable Sustenance or a mixed yield.

atoms.exact_source_text: Routine gathering and transport are abstracted beneath expedition scale.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine gathering and transport are abstracted beneath expedition scale.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away is the umbrella mode for expedition play beyond Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away is the umbrella mode for expedition play beyond Home.

atoms.exact_source_text: It may include Launch, TRAVEL, RISK, Crossing, MEET, Node interaction, exploration, Outpost establishment, Stopover, relaunch, and Return.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away may include Launch, TRAVEL, RISK, Crossing, MEET, Node interaction, exploration, Outpost establishment, Stopover, relaunch, and Return.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away is the umbrella.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away is the umbrella.

atoms.exact_source_text: Stopover and Homecoming are the paired expedition-resolution concepts.
atoms.normalized_claim: Stopover and Homecoming are the paired expedition-resolution concepts.

atoms.exact_source_text: Stopover is the restricted Outpost state entered when an expedition reaches an established Outpost.
atoms.normalized_claim: Stopover is the restricted Outpost state entered when an expedition reaches an established Outpost.

atoms.exact_source_text: It partially resolves expedition needs while preserving Away continuity.
atoms.normalized_claim: Stopover partially resolves expedition needs while preserving Away continuity.

atoms.exact_source_text: Use Shelter and reduce part of Exposure.
atoms.normalized_claim: During Stopover, the party may use Shelter and reduce part of Exposure.

atoms.exact_source_text: Repair damaged Tools through the Outpost affordance.
atoms.normalized_claim: During Stopover, damaged Tools may be repaired through the Outpost affordance.

atoms.exact_source_text: Offload Cargo into the single Colony Stock through abstract routine transport.
atoms.normalized_claim: During Stopover, Cargo may be offloaded into the single Colony Stock through abstract routine transport.

atoms.exact_source_text: Inspect Citizens, Cargo, Tools, Supplies, Keepsakes, Artifacts, and other Items.
atoms.normalized_claim: During Stopover, Citizens, Cargo, Tools, Supplies, Keepsakes, Artifacts, and other Items may be inspected.

atoms.exact_source_text: Choose a route, destination, Return, or relaunch.
atoms.normalized_claim: During Stopover, a route, destination, Return, or relaunch may be chosen.

atoms.exact_source_text: After Stopover resolution, the camera settles into one fixed authored composition using the visual language of DWELL.
atoms.normalized_claim: After Stopover resolution, the camera settles into one fixed authored composition using the visual language of DWELL.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Shelter, staging ground, party, Tools, Items, weather, Day Band, and Reach conditions remain visible.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Shelter, staging ground, party, Tools, Items, weather, Day Band, and Reach conditions remain visible.

atoms.exact_source_text: The camera cannot pan, rotate, or move between Places.
atoms.normalized_claim: The camera cannot pan, rotate, or move between Places.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Place claiming or spatial rearrangement.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Locked Outpost view, no Place claiming or spatial rearrangement is permitted.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Residence, Practice, Role, or Project management.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Locked Outpost view, no Residence, Practice, Role, or Project management is permitted.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Beautification, rearing, ceremony, Council, Gathering Place, Chronicle/Tale evaluation, or EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Locked Outpost view, no Beautification, rearing, ceremony, Council, Gathering Place, Chronicle/Tale evaluation, or EMBODY is permitted.

atoms.exact_source_text: No separate Outpost Stock or warehouse.
atoms.normalized_claim: In the Locked Outpost view, there is no separate Outpost Stock or warehouse.

atoms.exact_source_text: The locked view communicates: the Colony has made a place here, but it has not made a Home.
atoms.normalized_claim: The locked view communicates that the Colony has made a place here, but it has not made a Home.
